'''September 2000 Rochester tournament (16 September)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Millennium Games and Hobbies, Rochester, NY on 16 September 2000. [[Tom Colarocco]] won it. It is known from R. Smith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1255">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-20-rochester-ny-9-16-2000d1255/ rochester-ny-9-16-2000], DeckTech (R. "Voice of Law" Smith, 20 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-20-rochester-ny-9-16-2000d1255/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Millennium Games and Hobbies, Rochester, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 13
* '''Winner:''' [[Tom Colarocco]]
